meta.title: Contact & Feedback | Paychek
meta.description: Contact Paychek: support, product feedback, suggestions and affiliate program. We reply to every message.

hero.subtitle: A question, a bug, an idea to improve Paychek? Your feedback shapes the product. We reply quickly by email.

form.title: Send a message
form.subtitle: Same pipeline as in-app Support & Feedback (Settings). You will get a confirmation here.
form.hint: Your request is saved securely — our team is notified like in-app tickets.
form.success: Thank you! Your request was sent. Reference: {ref}. We will reply to your email shortly.
form.errorGeneric: Could not send. Check your connection or email us at contact@paychek.pro.
form.errorValidation: Please fill in a valid email and a message (8 characters minimum).

direct.title: Contact us directly
direct.appHintHtml: Already using Paychek? Open Settings → Support & Feedback to open a tracked ticket from your account.

affiliate.title: Recommend Paychek, get rewarded
affiliate.body: Content creator, mentor or trading community? Join our affiliate program and earn commission on every Pro subscription you refer.
